title.en: Abby Choi's mother testifies her husband gave her about HK$1 million a month for expenses
title.zh_hant: 蔡天鳳母親作供　稱丈夫每月給她約100萬元作開支
title.zh_hans: 蔡天凤母亲作供　称丈夫每月给她约100万元作开支

summary.en: In the High Court trial over the murder and dismemberment of Abby Choi, her mother Cheung Yin-hua continued to be cross-examined by the defence. She revealed that her husband gave her about HK$1 million a month in cash via a money changer for expenses, while the defence raised questions about Choi's finances and estate.
summary.zh_hant: 蔡天鳳被殺及肢解案在高等法院續審，死者母親張燕花繼續接受辯方盤問。她透露丈夫每月經兌換店以現金給她約100萬元作開支；辯方另就蔡天鳳的財務狀況及遺產金額提出質疑。
summary.zh_hans: 蔡天凤被杀及肢解案在高等法院续审，死者母亲张燕花继续接受辩方盘问。她透露丈夫每月经兑换店以现金给她约100万元作开支；辩方另就蔡天凤的财务状况及遗产金额提出质疑。

title.en: Mainland stocks soften at midday after holiday reopen, ChiNext falls over 2%
title.zh_hant: 滬深股市假期後復市半日走弱　創業板指數跌逾2%
title.zh_hans: 沪深股市假期后复市半日走弱　创业板指数跌逾2%

summary.en: Mainland stock markets resumed trading after the National Day holiday and weakened at the midday break, with the ChiNext index down more than 2%. Investors turned cautious after the holiday break.
summary.zh_hant: 內地股市假期後復市，半日走弱，創業板指數跌逾2%。假期後投資者情緒趨向審慎，拖累大市向下。
summary.zh_hans: 内地股市假期后复市，半日走弱，创业板指数跌逾2%。假期后投资者情绪趋向审慎，拖累大市向下。

title.en: Yangtze Delta railways carry over 27.7 million passengers during National Day holiday
title.zh_hant: 長三角鐵路國慶假期共發送旅客逾2770萬人次
title.zh_hans: 长三角铁路国庆假期共发送旅客逾2770万人次

summary.en: During the National Day holiday from October 1 to 7, railways in the Yangtze River Delta carried more than 27.7 million passengers, averaging over 3.95 million a day, with 2,567 extra passenger trains added over the period.
summary.zh_hant: 10月1日至7日國慶假期，長三角鐵路共發送旅客逾2770萬人次，日均超395萬人次，假期增開旅客列車2567列，應付龐大出行需求。
summary.zh_hans: 10月1日至7日国庆假期，长三角铁路共发送旅客逾2770万人次，日均超395万人次，假期增开旅客列车2567列，应付庞大出行需求。

title.en: Rosanna Law vows to review Film Development Fund to revitalise Hong Kong cinema
title.zh_hant: 羅淑佩稱政府檢視電影發展基金　讓香港電影業再次蓬勃發展
title.zh_hans: 罗淑佩称政府检视电影发展基金　让香港电影业再次蓬勃发展

summary.en: Culture, Sports and Tourism chief Rosanna Law said the government is reviewing the Film Development Fund and hopes optimised support will help Hong Kong's film industry flourish again.
summary.zh_hant: 文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩表示，政府正檢視電影發展基金，希望透過優化相關支援，讓香港電影業再次蓬勃發展。
summary.zh_hans: 文化体育及旅游局局长罗淑佩表示，政府正检视电影发展基金，希望透过优化相关支援，让香港电影业再次蓬勃发展。

title.en: Paul Lam to set up task force on legal liability for harm caused by AI products
title.zh_hant: 林定國稱將成立專責小組　研究運用AI產品造成損害的法律責任
title.zh_hans: 林定国称将成立专责小组　研究运用AI产品造成损害的法律责任

summary.en: Secretary for Justice Paul Lam said a dedicated task force will be set up to study how legal liability should be determined when harm is caused through the use of AI products.
summary.zh_hant: 律政司司長林定國表示，將成立專責小組，研究使用人工智能（AI）產品造成損害時，相關法律責任應如何釐定。
summary.zh_hans: 律政司司长林定国表示，将成立专责小组，研究使用人工智能（AI）产品造成损害时，相关法律责任应如何厘定。

title.en: Hong Kong stocks slip as tech muddles sovereign debt picture
title.zh_hant: 港股下跌　科技股表現受主權債務前景不明朗拖累
title.zh_hans: 港股下跌　科技股表现受主权债务前景不明朗拖累

summary.en: Hong Kong stocks fell as tech shares were weighed down by an unclear sovereign debt outlook, leaving investors in a cautious mood.
summary.zh_hant: 港股下跌，科技股表現受主權債務前景不明朗拖累，投資者情緒趨向審慎。
summary.zh_hans: 港股下跌，科技股表现受主权债务前景不明朗拖累，投资者情绪趋向审慎。

title.en: China-EU trade talks begin as Beijing reportedly rejects hybrid car export cap
title.zh_hant: 中國歐盟貿易談判今展開　金融時報：中國拒為混能車出口設限
title.zh_hans: 中国欧盟贸易谈判今展开　金融时报：中国拒为混能车出口设限

summary.en: China-EU trade negotiations kicked off today. According to the Financial Times, China has refused to cap exports of hybrid vehicles to Europe, a sticking point in the talks.
summary.zh_hant: 中國歐盟貿易談判今日展開。據金融時報報道，中國拒絕為混能車出口設限，成為談判焦點之一。
summary.zh_hans: 中国欧盟贸易谈判今日展开。据金融时报报道，中国拒绝为混能车出口设限，成为谈判焦点之一。

title.en: Transport Department briefs taxi trade on new Huanggang Port passenger arrangements
title.zh_hant: 運輸署向的士業界解說進出皇崗口岸接載乘客新安排
title.zh_hans: 运输署向的士业界解说进出皇岗口岸接载乘客新安排

summary.en: The Transport Department briefed the taxi trade on new arrangements for taxis entering and leaving Huanggang Port to pick up passengers, walking the industry through the operational details.
summary.zh_hant: 運輸署向的士業界講解進出皇崗口岸接載乘客的新安排，讓業界了解實際操作細節。
summary.zh_hans: 运输署向的士业界讲解进出皇岗口岸接载乘客的新安排，让业界了解实际操作细节。

title.en: WHO asks Russia for more information after second suspected pneumonia case at plague institute
title.zh_hant: 世衛要求俄國就疑似第二名員工感染不明肺炎　提供更多資料
title.zh_hans: 世卫要求俄国就疑似第二名员工感染不明肺炎　提供更多资料

summary.en: After a female researcher at a plague research institute in Russia's Irkutsk region died of pneumonia of unknown cause, WHO chief Tedros said the organisation has asked Moscow for more information and is watching reports of a second staff member falling ill. Russia says the local epidemic situation is stable.
summary.zh_hant: 俄羅斯伊爾庫茨克州一間鼠疫研究所一名女研究員死於不明原因肺炎後，世衛總幹事譚德塞表示已要求俄方提供更多資料，並關注有關第二名員工感染不明肺炎的報道；俄方則稱當地防疫形勢平穩。
summary.zh_hans: 俄罗斯伊尔库茨克州一间鼠疫研究所一名女研究员死于不明原因肺炎后，世卫总干事谭德塞表示已要求俄方提供更多资料，并关注有关第二名员工感染不明肺炎的报道；俄方则称当地防疫形势平稳。

title.en: Legco begins second day of debate on Hong Kong's first five-year plan and policy address
title.zh_hant: 立法會第二日辯論香港首份五年規劃及施政報告
title.zh_hans: 立法会第二日辩论香港首份五年规划及施政报告

summary.en: The Legislative Council began its second day of debate on Hong Kong's first five-year plan and the policy address, with members speaking on the plan's contents and policy directions.
summary.zh_hant: 立法會第二日辯論香港首份五年規劃及施政報告，多名議員就規劃內容及政策方向發言討論。
summary.zh_hans: 立法会第二日辩论香港首份五年规划及施政报告，多名议员就规划内容及政策方向发言讨论。

source.url: https://www.hk01.com/突發/60397375/秀茂坪邨立法會議員辦事處遭淋紅油-警列刑事毀壞追緝

title.en: Sau Mau Ping lawmakers' district office splashed with red paint, police investigate criminal damage
title.zh_hant: 秀茂坪邨立法會議員辦事處遭淋紅油　警列刑事毀壞追緝
title.zh_hans: 秀茂坪邨立法会议员办事处遭淋红油　警列刑事毁坏追缉

summary.en: At about 6:40am, police received a report that the metal gate and notice board of a joint district office of lawmakers Tang Ka-piu and Chan Pui-leung in Sau Chi House, Sau Mau Ping Estate, had been splashed with red paint. Police are treating the case as criminal damage and hunting for those involved.
summary.zh_hant: 今早6時40分，警方接報秀茂坪邨秀緻樓地下一間立法會議員聯合地區辦事處（鄧家彪、陳沛良）鐵閘同告示板被淋紅油。警方列「刑事毀壞」調查，正追緝涉案人士。
summary.zh_hans: 今早6时40分，警方接报秀茂坪邨秀致楼地下一间立法会议员联合地区办事处（邓家彪、陈沛良）铁闸和告示板被淋红油。警方列「刑事毁坏」调查，正追缉涉案人士。

title.en: Hong Kong stock ADRs broadly fall against local close; HSBC ADR down nearly 2%
title.zh_hant: 港股ADR普遍較本港收市下跌　滙控ADR跌近2%
title.zh_hans: 港股ADR普遍较本港收市下跌　汇控ADR跌近2%

summary.en: US-traded ADRs of Hong Kong stocks broadly fell compared with their Hong Kong closing levels, with HSBC's ADR down nearly 2% and AIA down more than 1%. Among tech names, most ATMXJ stocks fell, with Meituan down nearly 0.6% while JD.com rose more than 1%.
summary.zh_hant: 港股相關美國預托證券普遍較香港收市水平下跌，滙控ADR跌近2%、友邦跌逾1%。科技股ATMXJ多數下跌，其中美團跌近0.6%、京東升逾1%。
summary.zh_hans: 港股相关美国预托证券普遍较香港收市水平下跌，汇控ADR跌近2%、友邦跌逾1%。科技股ATMXJ多数下跌，其中美团跌近0.6%、京东升逾1%。

title.en: Major projects hit new milestones over National Day holiday; foreign trade stays vibrant
title.zh_hant: 國慶假期一批重大工程刷新「進度條」　外貿活力澎湃
title.zh_hans: 国庆假期一批重大工程刷新「进度条」　外贸活力澎湃

summary.en: Over the National Day holiday, a batch of major construction projects hit new milestones while foreign trade showed strong momentum. Key projects kept working through the holiday, posting fresh progress on multiple fronts.
summary.zh_hant: 國慶假期期間，一批重大工程刷新建設「進度條」，外貿表現活力澎湃。假期工程建設不停工，多個重點項目取得新進展。
summary.zh_hans: 国庆假期期间，一批重大工程刷新建设「进度条」，外贸表现活力澎湃。假期工程建设不停工，多个重点项目取得新进展。

title.en: China's autumn grain harvest passes 40% of expected area
title.zh_hant: 全國秋糧收穫過四成
title.zh_hans: 全国秋粮收获过四成

summary.en: China's autumn grain harvest has passed 40% of the expected area. Regions are racing the farming season with mechanised harvesting to bring the autumn grain in.
summary.zh_hant: 全國秋糧收穫進度已超過四成。各地搶抓農時組織機械化收穫，確保秋糧顆粒歸倉。
summary.zh_hans: 全国秋粮收获进度已超过四成。各地抢抓农时组织机械化收获，确保秋粮颗粒归仓。

title.en: Gold prices fall more than 1% as stronger dollar and high US bond yields weigh
title.zh_hant: 金價跌逾1%　美元上升及美債息高企拖累
title.zh_hans: 金价跌逾1%　美元上升及美债息高企拖累

summary.en: New York gold futures closed at US$4,140.7 an ounce, down 1.1%, while spot gold earlier traded at US$4,106.74, down nearly 1.4%. Gold was weighed down by a stronger US dollar and elevated US Treasury yields.
summary.zh_hant: 紐約期金收市報每盎司4,140.7美元，跌1.1%；現貨金較早時報4,106.74美元，跌近1.4%。美元走強及美國國債息率高企拖累金價。
summary.zh_hans: 纽约期金收市报每盎司4,140.7美元，跌1.1%；现货金较早时报4,106.74美元，跌近1.4%。美元走强及美国国债息率高企拖累金价。

title.en: Oil prices fall as IEA speeds up reserve releases to ease supply fears
title.zh_hant: 油價下跌　IEA加快釋放儲備紓緩供應憂慮
title.zh_hans: 油价下跌　IEA加快释放储备纾缓供应忧虑

summary.en: Brent crude closed at US$100.2 a barrel, down nearly 0.4%, while New York crude fell about 1.3% to US$88.28. The International Energy Agency earlier agreed to accelerate releases of oil reserves to ease market concerns over supply.
summary.zh_hant: 倫敦布蘭特期油收市報每桶100.2美元，跌近0.4%；紐約期油報88.28美元，跌約1.3%。國際能源署此前同意加快釋放石油儲備，以紓緩市場對供應的憂慮。
summary.zh_hans: 伦敦布兰特期油收市报每桶100.2美元，跌近0.4%；纽约期油报88.28美元，跌约1.3%。国际能源署此前同意加快释放石油储备，以纾缓市场对供应的忧虑。

title.en: Thailand flood death toll rises to 60; new round of heavy rain expected
title.zh_hant: 泰國洪災死亡人數升至60人　多地將迎新一輪強降雨
title.zh_hans: 泰国洪灾死亡人数升至60人　多地将迎新一轮强降雨

summary.en: Flooding in Thailand since September 16 has killed 60 people, with Bangkok and 27 provinces affected. The Thai Meteorological Department warned of heavy to very heavy rain in many areas from October 9 to 13, and the government called for stronger cross-province water management, flood control and drainage.
summary.zh_hant: 泰國自9月16日以來的洪災已造成60人死亡，曼谷及27個府受災。泰國氣象局預警10月9日至13日多地將出現大到暴雨，政府要求加強跨府水量調度同防洪排澇。
summary.zh_hans: 泰国自9月16日以来的洪灾已造成60人死亡，曼谷及27个府受灾。泰国气象局预警10月9日至13日多地将出现大到暴雨，政府要求加强跨府水量调度和防洪排涝。

title.en: Magnitude 4.8 earthquake strikes northeastern Chiba; felt in Tokyo
title.zh_hant: 日本千葉縣東北部發生4.8級地震　東京有震感
title.zh_hans: 日本千叶县东北部发生4.8级地震　东京有震感

summary.en: Japan's Meteorological Agency reported a magnitude 4.8 earthquake in northeastern Chiba in the early hours, with a focal depth of about 50 km. Shaking was felt clearly across Tokyo and the capital region; the agency confirmed there is no tsunami risk.
summary.zh_hant: 日本氣象廳通報，千葉縣東北部凌晨發生4.8級地震，震源深度約50公里。東京等首都圈地區震感明顯，氣象廳確認無海嘯風險。
summary.zh_hans: 日本气象厅通报，千叶县东北部凌晨发生4.8级地震，震源深度约50公里。东京等首都圈地区震感明显，气象厅确认无海啸风险。

title.en: Turkey reportedly has no plans for a military base in Saudi Arabia for now
title.zh_hant: 土耳其據報目前無意在沙特設軍事基地
title.zh_hans: 土耳其据报目前无意在沙特设军事基地

summary.en: Turkish foreign ministry sources said Turkey currently has no intention of setting up a military base in Saudi Arabia, and has not held consultations with Riyadh on the matter. The remarks respond to recent speculation about Turkish-Saudi military cooperation.
summary.zh_hant: 土耳其外交部消息人士透露，土方目前無意在沙特阿拉伯設立軍事基地，亦未就此與沙特方面磋商。消息回應近日有關土沙兩國軍事合作的傳聞。
summary.zh_hans: 土耳其外交部消息人士透露，土方目前无意在沙特阿拉伯设立军事基地，亦未就此与沙特方面磋商。消息回应近日有关土沙两国军事合作的传闻。

title.en: IMF expects high oil prices to persist into next year as supply stays tight
title.zh_hant: IMF 預計高油價將持續至明年　即使產油國增產供應仍緊張
title.zh_hans: IMF 预计高油价将持续至明年　即使产油国增产供应仍紧张

summary.en: The International Monetary Fund said in a report that elevated oil prices are expected to persist into 2026. It noted that even with production increases from Saudi Arabia and other oil producers, tight global crude supply would be hard to ease.
summary.zh_hant: 國際貨幣基金組織發表報告，預計高油價情況將持續至 2026 年。報告指，即使沙特等產油國增加產量，全球原油供應緊張的局面仍難緩解。
summary.zh_hans: 国际货币基金组织发表报告，预计高油价情况将持续至 2026 年。报告指，即使沙特等产油国增加产量，全球原油供应紧张的局面仍难缓解。

title.en: Putin and Pezeshkian hold phone call, pledge deeper Russia-Iran strategic cooperation
title.zh_hant: 普京與佩澤希齊揚通話　強調繼續加強俄伊雙邊戰略合作
title.zh_hans: 普京与佩泽希齐扬通话　强调继续加强俄伊双边战略合作

summary.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin held a phone call with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, with both sides stressing that Russia-Iran bilateral strategic cooperation should continue to be strengthened. No details of specific cooperation were disclosed.
summary.zh_hant: 俄羅斯總統普京與伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚通電話，雙方強調應繼續加強兩國雙邊戰略合作。通話未透露具體合作細節。
summary.zh_hans: 俄罗斯总统普京与伊朗总统佩泽希齐扬通电话，双方强调应继续加强两国双边战略合作。通话未透露具体合作细节。

title.en: Only 40% of taxi owners join EV taxi subsidy scheme, environment chief cites economic caution
title.zh_hant: 資助換電動的士僅四成車主參加　謝展寰：經濟轉變令換車更審慎
title.zh_hans: 资助换电动的士仅四成车主参加　谢展寰：经济转变令换车更审慎

summary.en: The government's EV taxi subsidy scheme, launched in December 2024 with a target of subsidising 3,000 electric taxis, has seen only about 40% of invited owners take part as of August this year, with 3,578 owners accepting quotas. Environment chief Tse Chin-wan told lawmakers that changes in the economic environment have made owners more cautious about replacing vehicles.
summary.zh_hant: 政府於 2024 年 12 月推出電動的士資助計劃，目標資助業界購買 3,000 輛電動的士。截至今年 8 月，受邀車主中僅約四成參加，共有 3,578 名車主接受配額。環境及生態局局長謝展寰回應立法會質詢時表示，經濟環境轉變令車主換車更審慎。
summary.zh_hans: 政府于 2024 年 12 月推出电动的士资助计划，目标资助业界购买 3,000 辆电动的士。截至今年 8 月，受邀车主中仅约四成参加，共有 3,578 名车主接受配额。环境及生态局局长谢展寰回应立法会质询时表示，经济环境转变令车主换车更审慎。

title.en: Iran's IRGC says illegal shipping lanes in Strait of Hormuz to be shut
title.zh_hant: 伊朗革命衛隊稱將關閉霍爾木茲海峽非法航道
title.zh_hans: 伊朗革命卫队称将关闭霍尔木兹海峡非法航道

summary.en: A senior adviser to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said a handful of 'illegal channels' in the Strait of Hormuz used for oil smuggling by small boats would soon be closed. He said the strait is already under the full control of Iran's armed forces, and the situation will persist until Iran's legitimate demands are met.
summary.zh_hant: 伊朗革命衛隊高級顧問納格迪表示，霍爾木茲海峽內少數被利用小型船隻走私石油的「非法航道」即將被關閉。他強調海峽目前已處於伊朗武裝部隊的完全控制之下，除非伊朗的正當訴求得到滿足，局勢將持續下去。
summary.zh_hans: 伊朗革命卫队高级顾问纳格迪表示，霍尔木兹海峡内少数被利用小型船只走私石油的「非法航道」即将被关闭。他强调海峡目前已处于伊朗武装部队的完全控制之下，除非伊朗的正当诉求得到满足，局势将持续下去。
